description: Shared Renovate config for leadershipmosaics repos. Extends config:best-practices (the maintained upstream baseline); encodes the two-tier dependency currency model (lm_app ADR-0004 and its update-cadence.md policy table). Divergences from the upstream baseline must carry a recorded rationale.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security PRs are never auto-merged: Renovate applies vulnerabilityAlerts after packageRules, so this beats the Tier 1 automerge rules (ruling 2026-10-23, leadershipmosaics/lm_app#1718)

packageRules.description: Tier 1: Group all non-major npm updates
Tier 1: Auto-merge minor npm updates (post-1.0 packages); a grouped PR auto-merges only when every update in it qualifies (README)
Tier 1: Group GitHub Actions minor/patch updates

Tool and runtime versions passed through a with: block (depType uses-with, e.g. python-version) are runtime tooling: never auto-merge (lm_app ADR-0004 P4; lm_governance#87). The group rule above lists every other github-actions depType so this one stays out of the auto-merged group

Tool versions pinned in .mise.toml (mise manager) are runtime tooling: never auto-merge, any update type (lm_app ADR-0004 P4, update-cadence.md Cadence Summary). The patch rule above has no manager filter, so without this a post-1.0 mise patch, pin or digest update is auto-merge-eligible. Because a grouped PR auto-merges only when every update in it has automerge, a consumer group that contains a mise update, such as lm_app's supabase CLI group, turns manual (operator ruling 2026-10-29, closing the gap recorded in leadershipmosaics/lm_app#1751)
Tier 2: Major updates require manual review (governed decision per the dependency currency practice; sequential stepping via :separateMultipleMajorReleases)
